proposed_capability: Portable, deterministic, machine-readable object-interaction discovery: every semantically observed player/host object menu, selection and outcome accumulates class-based action knowledge usable for safe queue recommendations across saves.
player_save_control_impact: Read-only opt-in, bounded semantic event observations and reviewed utility; no user save or game files, OS input settings, mouse/keyboard hooks, automation daemon or game side effects. Player's control, selected Sim and queue actions protected. Advisory-only catalog cannot issue a control permit.
expected_outcome: Portable per game patch/object class/action catalogue of observed availability, selection and reviewed outcomes, replay-safe idempotent atomic storage; exact live menu freshness queries attached to existing listener opportunity survey as candidate suggestions never dispatched. Negative tests and CI.
negative_tests: No learned ability from tooltip/menu appearance or unreviewed outcomes
No candidate while player active or owns queue
Selection outside visible fresh menu denied
Post-action outcomes must match an interaction and distinct capture
Replays idempotent; sequence gaps denied; bounded local persistence
No raw text or personal save/Sim names in global class labels
No autonomous interaction or control permit
rollback_path: Revert isolated feature branch or merge commit. Existing opt-in hover/affordance and listener queue logic retain behavior; no new live hooks or storage migration. BI-002 stays active.
unresolved_unknowns: Local Sims executable is inaccessible through GitHub provider; independent P08 game sensor coverage, menu/selector fidelity, gameplay outcome calibration and live input authority unproven
Exact patch and source observation sensor adapters must submit semantic user and host events to existing opt-in listener; not automatically attached
Concurrent PR #159 spatial perception and PR #149 needs/homework owned separately; preserve non-overlapping changes
decision_rationale: Scoped extension of existing session lifecycle and passive opportunity survey; strict reviewed evidence and human-first abstention instead of universal global click observation.

prior_design_decisions.name: Global OS click/key capture
prior_design_decisions.reason: violates human-first/peripheral sovereignty and conflates UI clicks with object semantics

prior_design_decisions.name: Hardcoded list of Sims object IDs and interactions
prior_design_decisions.reason: not portable across saves, packs, patches or object variants

prior_design_decisions.name: Extend existing hover schema to include all menu semantics
prior_design_decisions.reason: would break existing validated event shape and mix tooltip with menu observation

prior_design_decisions.name: Separate bounded semantic object-event port adjoining host_listener
prior_design_decisions.reason: reuses session lifecycle and keeps captured facts separate from learned usefulness
